title: We Love Because He First Loved Us

request.style: English, warm female soul voice, solo with gospel choir, piano, Rhodes, upright bass, drums, cello, intimate and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We have come to know this deep truth
Believing the love that He shows us
God is love, simple and true
Remain in it, let His peace flow through

[Pre-Chorus]
In this way, love is brought to completion
Giving us confidence on judgment day
As He is, so are we in this world
Walking together in the light

[Chorus]
We love because He first loved us
We love because He first loved us
No fear remains where His grace is found
Perfect love drives the fear away

[Verse]
There is no fear in this holy love
It drives out the dread of punishment
The one who fears has not been made complete
But we stand secure in His presence

[Chorus]
We love because He first loved us
We love because He first loved us
No fear remains where His grace is found
Perfect love drives the fear away

[Bridge]
If you say you love the unseen God
You cannot hate the brother you have seen
This is the command we hold dear
Love the brother, love the Lord

[Chorus]
We love because He first loved us
We love because He first loved us
No fear remains where His grace is found
Perfect love drives the fear away

[Outro]
We love because He first loved us
He first loved us
